extracted.intended_audience: Participants in the DS106 Daily Create (DS106 community) and Mastodon users submitting creative responses
extracted.subtask_description: A DS106 Daily Create prompt asking creators to imagine themselves transforming into a chess piece and to present an intermediate stage of that transformation, posted as a response on Mastodon with the specified tag. The response is oriented toward visual/design work (photo/graphic) and must be submitted through Mastodon with the required tag/attribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Which chess piece will you become?
rubrics_metrics.description: You’re turning into a chess piece. Which one will you become?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose a specific chess piece (king, queen, rook, bishop, knight, pawn) and consider its characteristics when imagining your transformation. No explicit scoring guidance provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Show an intermediate stage of the change process
rubrics_metrics.description: Show us an intermediate stage of your change process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present an intermediate/transitional moment rather than a completed transformation; the prompt implies a visual depiction (photograph, illustration, collage, or other visual/design medium). The page is organized under 'Design' and 'Visual', indicating a visual response is expected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission method and tag requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Reply in Mastodon for this Daily Create to @ [email protected] and include the tag #tdc4645
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Responses must be posted on Mastodon and include the hashtag #tdc4645. The page provides a 'Launch in Mastodon' link to follow and submit the Create. Follow the specified submission channel to have the response associated with the Daily Create.
